experiments.title: Brush + MoSca hybrid scene
experiments.description: Aligned Brush background plus MoSca motion; visitor-mask follow-up improves lower-scene appearance, geometry remains coarse.

experiments.title: Brush + MoSca · seven scene tests
experiments.description: Seven short scene tests: five fresh monocular motion fits plus two static-only motion failures. Compare MoSca controls with hybrids; whole-person masks currently discard stationary people/body parts.

experiments.title: Brush + MoSca · whole-person layer
experiments.description: Full MoSca quality baseline and corrected hybrid development path. Matched people-layer controls plus separate background seed/optimization candidates; monocular motion, no joint multi-phone fusion.

experiments.title: Calibrated two-camera trial
experiments.description: Two synchronized calibrated recordings refine one shared MoSca-initialized Gaussian sequence. Second fitted view improves; elevated held-out person reconstruction fails. Switch recorded cameras without changing event time. Includes native renderer checks.

experiments.title: Shared camera coordinates
experiments.description: Background-only camera recovery: full-resolution known-calibration control passes; Medium joins three phones, Easy fails. Sparse landmarks and camera path glyphs, no dynamic reconstruction.

experiments.title: Phone SLAM pose priors
experiments.description: Verified global SLAM coordinate convention; fixed/refined sparse maps support three phones but do not improve strict later-frame localization. Static diagnostics only; image-only map remains preferred.

experiments.title: Assembled multi-view hybrid
experiments.description: Recovered two-camera SfM world, fresh masked Brush background, saved complete-person MoSca layer and shared refinement. Training views/room improve; fresh-view person appearance regresses. Compare matched reference, assembled and refined outputs.

experiments.title: Incremental scene fusion
experiments.description: Simulated late upload enriches an existing Brush/MoSca scene at one instant. Compare saved A, aligned additions and refined additions; partial coverage gains, graininess and missing stress-view shoes remain.

experiments.title: Guildhall / MoSca vs precise-mask hybrid
experiments.description: Matched same-event comparison: all-points MoSca, the exact H1 precise-mask hybrid, and the same hybrid without motion subsampling. Same camera, clock and color conventions; saved reconstructions, no retraining.

experiments.title: Independent full MoSca / two-video fusion
experiments.description: A, independently fitted B, and raw additive union from two studio angles with staggered source intervals. Full density, common clock, similarity alignment; retain any failed alignment and duplicate surfaces.

experiments.title: Full MoSca / background registration
experiments.description: Five preserved all-point comparisons: A, original union, background registration, local ICP, scene-balanced transform. Room improves but person ghosts persist; no overall alignment winner.

experiments.title: Integrated fusion prototype / two uploads
experiments.description: Cached independent A/B uploads, recovered clock, room/person gates, full raw/consolidated/refined candidates. Actor geometry fails; originals retained and candidates rejected.

experiments.title: Edge registration / diagnostics
experiments.description: Original controls, previous union and room-edge-aligned union. All points and shared clocks/cameras. Geometry/person gates fail; raw candidate rejected, originals retained.

experiments.title: Learned splat registration / diagnostics
experiments.description: Real pretrained GaussReg coarse and splatreg/BUFFER-X on independent full MoSca splats. Both real merges fail room/person gates; all points and shared clocks/cameras retained.

experiments.title: Fresh original videos / full MoSca + alignment
experiments.description: Fresh A/B depth, tracks, cameras and full models; one unvalidated learned raw union, controls retained.

experiments.title: Guildhall full video / fresh shot-aware MoSca
experiments.description: Full30s source, separate freshly reconstructed interior/outro; dissolve remains source-only. Native comparisons and costs recorded.

experiments.title: MoSca depth and tracker comparisons
experiments.description: Three-video model screen: eight complete exports and one retained curve-filter failure. Native fitted-view scores are development evidence; full quality promotion remains unavailable.

experiments.title: MoSca / Guildhall duration ladder
experiments.description: Four completed duration exports through12s. Full interior is on hold pending user review of the12s result. Source-view scores do not establish novel-view fidelity.

experiments.title: MoSca / L40S full Guildhall
experiments.description: L40S native preflight and full305-frame priors passed, but background-track geometry was inconsistent. Stopped before appearance fitting; no full-interior export. The separate outro was not started.

experiments.title: MoSca / corrected full Guildhall
experiments.description: Depth-validity correction improved median geometry to1.75px, but late-after-turn errors failed review. No appearance training, outro or full-length export.

experiments.title: MoSca / overlapping Guildhall camera windows
experiments.description: 0–18s camera BA passes; independently initialized14–25.3s fails. No scaffold, appearance, stitching or model export.

experiments.title: MoSca / static world first
experiments.description: 305 static-map cameras qualify; locked-camera depth BA passes all error gates at1.50px median/5.28px worst-frame median with unchanged poses. Final six frames have58–62 static anchors versus64 required. No motion/appearance export.

experiments.title: MoSca / observed static anchors and depth refinement
experiments.description: Identical4000 observed static-map tracks and fixed cameras: full-depth0.76px median/1.06px worst-frame versus scale-only0.97/1.58px. All305 frames have at least288 usable anchors. No appearance, motion or full-length model export.

experiments.title: MoSca / fixed-world full interior
experiments.description: Full0–25.3s interior with fixed cameras. Exploratory:87 frames have sparse motion support, so people and novel views remain unvalidated. The edited transition and separate outro are not reconstructed.

experiments.title: Core pipeline / timing controls
experiments.description: Fresh fixed-world video trials with measured stage time, cost and retained failures. Sculpture is a static control; dynamic replay is not established by it.
